Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in the final step of the conversation. After the WebSurfer correctly identified the spouse as "Mapy Cortés" (based on the Wikipedia snippet visible in the search results which stated "married... María del Pilar Cordero, who adopted the stage name of Mapy Cortés"), the Planner incorrectly analyzed the result. The Planner's analysis claimed the WebSurfer indicated the spouse was "Mapita Cortés" (a different name entirely) rather than "Mapy Cortés". Consequently, the Planner concluded the final answer was "Mapita Cortés" instead of the correct "Mapy Cortés". This hallucination in the analysis step led directly to the wrong solution being presented as complete.
